claim.value: The reintroduction exercise must not weaken live controls.
claim.scope: A boundary on the responsibility-ambiguity exercise.

provenance.rationale: P011 explicitly imposes this boundary on simulated reintroduction.

signal_basis.value: Reintroduce ambiguity only through safe simulation with fictitious orders and comparable tasks, without weakening live controls; stop if real purchases could be affected. Recurrence followed by improvement when clarity returns is a simulation-specific signal.
signal_basis.scope: The simulated reintroduction exercise and its operational safety boundaries.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the simulation procedure, live-control boundary, stopping condition and bounded signal.
The claim is an explicit procedural constraint; no unresolved empirical relation is needed to license it.

rationale: The claim states a boundary constitutive of the described operation. The mapping expressly prohibits weakening live controls and requires stopping a simulation that could affect real purchases. Observing the signal does not relax that boundary.
uncertainty: No material uncertainty about this procedural boundary.
